dedupe_keys.name: flood hazard maps and associated data for case study funding rules that promote equity in climate adaptation outcomes

description: Sara Santamaria-Aguilar and colleagues publish inundation grids for multiple return periods and scenarios used in a climate-adaptation funding study. Zenodo provides an open ZIP under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Its linked public code repository documents compound coastal and rainfall boundary-condition methods and identifies Gloucester City, New Jersey as the flood-model case. The grids can support flood-exposure, benefit-allocation or adaptation-sensitivity simulations for local infrastructure. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these study grids. A limitation is that the Zenodo page does not list the internal raster format, spatial resolution or exact scenario set. The linked workflow combines coastal and pluvial floodplains, and its results depend on rainfall bias correction and extreme-event definitions. The archive was not downloaded and neither inundation depth nor equity outcome was independently reproduced.
